text:
A: Hello! Finally I get the mechanic! Everyone's been talking about you. I'm Chiamaka, Leeds.
B: Alright. Ryan. Castleford. What've they been saying?
A: Only good things! Joanne said you sorted her sister's clutch. Over the phone, like a doctor!
B: Didn't sort it. Just said the price weren't mad.
A: That's what I do half the time! Reassure people. So Castleford, that's down the road from me, basically.
B: Yeah. Half an hour. Sister lives in Leeds.
A: Oh, which part?
B: Horsforth.
A: Okay, posh! I'm in Chapel Allerton. Do you come up much?
B: Not really. Rugby, sometimes. When Cas play Leeds.
A: Oh, I go to Rhinos games! My partner's mates get tickets. I'm not going to lie, I go for the atmosphere and the drinks after, I don't really know the rules.
B: You're Rhinos, then.
A: Is that a problem? Are we enemies now?
B: Bit. Tigers lost again Saturday, so. Not in the mood.
A: Oh no! Sorry, sorry. I'll keep my scarf hidden.
B: S'alright.
A: So what do you do after work, Ryan? Tell me something.
B: Walk the dog. Have me tea. PlayStation. Fishing on a Sunday sometimes in summer.
A: Fishing! Do you catch anything?
B: Sometimes. Put 'em back. It's more just sitting there. Quiet. No phone.
A: No phone, that sounds like heaven. After nights I just lie on the sofa and watch Love Island with Deliveroo. I've got a freezer full of jollof I made, and I still order Deliveroo, do you know what I mean? I forget it's there.
B: Chloe does that with the chilli.
A: Is Chloe your girlfriend? See, we're the same person.
B: Erm. Can I ask you summat? Medical, like.
A: Of course, go on.
B: Me dad had a heart scare last year. Stent. He's back at work, says he's fine. But he still has a fry-up every morning. Is that, like. Is he alright doing that?
A: Okay. Honestly? A fry-up every single morning after a stent isn't ideal. But you know what works better than nagging? If he's got cardiac rehab or a follow-up, someone goes with him. Dads listen to the nurse, not the son. And if he ever gets chest pain, or breathless, he rings 999, he doesn't drive himself, he doesn't wait to see. That's the main thing.
B: He'd drive himself. Definitely.
A: They always do! Tell him a Leeds doctor said no.
B: He'll love that. Rhinos fan an' all.
A: Ha! Don't tell him that part.
B: Cheers, though. Honestly.
A: Any time. You're less quiet than your picture, you know.
B: Rugby helps.
